reasons.overallMobile: Coherent and completable portrait mission with clear recovery/extraction feedback and attractive consistent art. Combat tracking and dense small HUD cues limit confidence; assists did much of navigation.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE plus FIRE drag and scene turning visibly work. Tap aim and large anchored controls help. Charging patrol tracking was uncertain in both attempts; continuous burst rearming and physical thumb comfort are unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, coil exposure phases and uplink form a readable mission arc. Offscreen charging patrols made combat hard to interpret. Route-assisted completion alone gives limited evidence of independent navigation or sustained combat enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber industrial rain atmosphere, coherent gun/world/menu styling and a polished result card in the viewed scenes. No audio assessment.
reasons.usability: Contextual hold labels, route guidance, explicit fresh start and assist stats help. Some assisted turns briefly leave a wall-facing view; manual pursuit requires more correction.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and high-contrast contextual labels are useful; small distant enemies, fine spaced type, top banners and threat cues compete in 390px width.

observationProtocol.method: Each screenshot viewed in a separate tool call before adaptive input. At most one new scene target tap per batch; subsequent FIRE anchored. No new image and dependent input in same orchestration call.
observationProtocol.boundaries: Read observationBoundary/timings on each batch; shortened waits accepted and no bypass. Maximum requested wait 3000ms (below 12000ms). One 600ms phase wait and 1500ms final wait.
observationProtocol.limitations: Captures release all contacts then pause; live image precedes pause, so AIM state cannot be assumed after resume. No tools/aim used. Paused inspection frequency cannot establish human reaction-time behavior or a causal quality benefit.
